facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's Plano de Melhoria de Qualidade de Dados 2025-2029, dated Maputo, January 2025, is a national plan for the quality of data in SIS-MA, drawn up after the ministry's 2022-23 national assessment of 175 of 180 planned facilities in all 11 provinces found that only 9% of records matched exactly between facility source registers and SIS-MA.

systems.country_label: Sistema de Informação para Saúde / SIS-MA
